A report is not a flag. Flags are signed and public and hide a record by consensus; a report leaves the ledger and reaches a person, for content that breaks the law or the store\'s rules.

Nothing here can delete an on-chain record — not us, not the store, not a court. A report can lead to it being hidden in this app and passed to Solana Mobile. It opens your mail app; no report is sent from the app itself, and nothing about you is collected.
